# Subly — Digital Subscriptions & Verified Accounts Hub

> Subly is a premier digital subscription broker and verified accounts store in Nigeria, delivering discounted premium digital services via instant WhatsApp activation with a 100% active warranty and 5-minute delivery promise.

## Core Products & Services

### Entertainment & Music
- **Spotify Premium**: Individual & Family Plans (starting from ₦2,000/mo). Direct email upgrade or dedicated accounts.
- **YouTube Premium**: Ad-free background play, downloads, YouTube Music (starting from ₦2,500/mo).
- **Netflix Premium**: Ultra HD 4K single screen profiles and private account plans (starting from ₦3,500/mo).
- **Apple Music**: High-res lossless spatial audio subscriptions.

### Productivity & AI
- **ChatGPT Plus**: GPT-4o, DALL-E, Advanced Voice Mode (starting from ₦12,500/mo).
- **Canva Pro**: Full creative suite, background remover, brand kits, premium stock assets (from ₦1,500/mo).
- **CapCut Pro**: Desktop & mobile video editing pro transitions and effects (from ₦2,500/mo).
- **TradingView**: Essential, Plus, and Premium technical analysis plans.

### Privacy & VPNs
- **ExpressVPN**: High-speed servers across 105 countries, multi-device setup.
- **Surfshark VPN**: Unlimited simultaneous devices, clean web, anti-tracking.
- **Private Internet Access (PIA)** & **ProtonVPN**.

### Pre-Activated Social Accounts
- **Verified X (Twitter) Accounts**: Aged accounts (2010–2023), Premium Blue badges, organic follower bases ready for immediate handover.

## Ordering & Fulfillment Process
1. Browse catalog on web (`https://subly.store/services.html`) or select account (`https://subly.store/accounts.html`).
2. Customize plan duration and generate WhatsApp order token.
3. Chat with verified Subly agent on WhatsApp (`+234 704 792 9177`).
4. Instant activation or login credentials dispatched in under 5 minutes.

## Guarantees & Support
- **Delivery Time Guarantee**: Within 5 minutes of payment confirmation.
- **100% Active Replacement Warranty**: Any downtime, profile reset, or password issue is resolved or replaced immediately.
- **Support Hours**: 24/7 Live Customer Assistance via WhatsApp.
